## The claim

P4-3: every precomputed missense table that runs covers at least 90 % of the callset's missense alleles, EVE excepted (predicted below 30 %).

**Prediction if true.** For each missense lane that runs, mva-zoo coverage's by-consequence row for missense_variant shows scored/total >= 0.90 of the 15,620 missense alleles in results.it4_allele_records.

**What would refute it.** Any missense table other than EVE covers below 70 % of the callset's missense alleles.
